SG1.text: However, in relation to goods of class 1, segregation as for the primary hazard (SG1).

SG23.text: Stow “away from” animal or vegetable oils (SG23).

SG25.text: Stow “separated from” goods of classes 2.1 and 3 (SG25).

SG26.text: In addition: from goods of classes 2.1 and 3 when stowed on deck of a containership a minimum distance of two container spaces athwartship shall be maintained, when stowed on ro-ro ships a distance of 6 m athwartship shall be maintained (SG26).

SG27.text: Stow “away from” explosives containing chlorates or perchlorates (SG27).

SG28.text: Stow “away from” SGG2 – ammonium compounds and explosives containing ammonium compounds or salts (SG28).

SG29.text: Segregation from foodstuffs as in 7.3.4.2.2, 7.6.3.1.2 or 7.7.3.7 (SG29).

SG30.text: Stow “away from” SGG7 – heavy metals and their salts (SG30).

SG31.text: Stow “away from” SGG9 – lead and its compounds (SG31).

SG32.text: Stow “away from” SGG10 – liquid halogenated hydrocarbons (SG32).

SG34.text: When containing ammonium compounds, “away from” SGG4 – chlorates or SGG13 – perchlorates and explosives containing chlorates or perchlorates (SG34).

SG39.text: Stow “separated from” SGG2 – ammonium compounds other than AMMONIUM PERSULPHATE (UN 1444) (SG39).

SG40.text: Stow “separated from” SGG2 – ammonium compounds other than mixtures of ammonium persulphates and/or potassium persulphates and/or sodium persulphates (SG40).

SG41.text: Stow “separated from” animal or vegetable oil (SG41).

SG48.text: Combustible material does not include packing materials or dunnage (SG48).

SG54.text: Stow “separated from” SGG11 – mercury and mercury compounds (SG54).

SG63.text: Stow “separated longitudinally by an intervening complete compartment or hold from” class 1 (SG63).

SG65.text: Stow “separated by a complete compartment or hold from” class 1 except for division 1.4 (SG65).

SG67.text: Stow “separated from” division 1.4 and “separated longitudinally by an intervening complete compartment of hold from” divisions 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.5 and 1.6 except from explosives of compatibility group J (SG67).

SG68.text: or below, segregation as for class 3 but “away from” class 4.1 (SG68).
